title: Process Contribution
description: Schema for process contributions submitted to contributions/processes/. CR-BP-03 §9. A contribution is the human-in-the-loop entry point for new processes: the contributor submits a YAML file conforming to this schema, the CI contribution report workflow generates a reclassification recommendation, and a catalog maintainer reviews the recommendation before the entry lands in entities/v1-alpha/.

schema.description: Schema discriminator. Locks the file to CR-BP-03 contribution shape.

proposed_entry.description: The proposed L2 Business Process entry. Must conform to schemas/entity.schema.json (with the new CR-BP-03 fields). The CI contribution report cross-checks this against the identity sub-block + classification vocabulary.

id.description: Proposed canonical id. Must follow the dea:process-... convention (per CR-BP-02 PC-008 + CR-BP-03C §2).

name.description: Proposed name. Should be `<verb> <object>` (matching identity.verb + identity.object).

process_intent.description: Process Intent (CR-BP-14 §9). Canonical vocabulary: govern / manage / operate / deliver / support / develop / transform (classifications/process-intents.yaml). Legacy values `operational` / `management` remain readable as deprecated migration aliases (§17). Mirrors schemas/entity.schema.json.

process_type.description: Process Classification: 5-component landscape position (Mintzberg). NEW in CR-BP-03; retained by CR-BP-14 §10.2. NOT a synonym for process_intent (§11, §18).

process_classification.description: Canonical Process Classification block (CR-BP-14 §10, §20). Mirrors schemas/entity.schema.json.

process_audience.description: Legacy migration alias (CR-BP-14 §13, §19). New contributions should prefer contextual relationships over this single-axis audience value.

process_specialization.description: Optional: list of parent process ids this entry specializes. Multi-inheritance permitted.

identity.description: Process identity sub-block. Must conform to schemas/identity.schema.json.

context.description: Process Context placement (CR-BP-14 §13, §20). Preferred over the legacy process_audience value for new contributions. Mirrors schemas/entity.schema.json.

relationships.description: Canonical OpenDEA relationships (CR-BP-03 §6; CR-BP-03A §3.1). Array of relationship instances conforming to the metamodel's relationship-instance.json. The catalog primarily uses 'composes' (structural composition) and 'realizes' (capability realization). The legacy parent_process / child_processes / capabilities_delivered fields are NOT part of the contribution schema (they have been removed or soft-deprecated in the entity schema).

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the contribution. The contribution report cross-references this evidence.

reviewer.description: GitHub handle of the assigned reviewer. If empty, the catalog maintainers team is the implicit reviewer.

status.description: Current status of the contribution. 'pending' on submission; updated by the reviewer (or by the contributor after a re-landscape request).

report.description: Filled by the CI contribution report workflow. Contributors do not write this section.
